Rohit Varma Kola

PowerApps Developer

Aiming to learn, innovate & enrich my skills in the leading areas of technology to bring out the best from my devoted efforts & add value to my work in conjunction with the organization's objectives. I am excited about the opportunity to be part of a team that specializes in Microsoft Power Platform, including Copilot Studio PowerApps and Power Automate.

WORK EXPERIENCE

PowerApps Developer

Tata Consultancy services

12/2021 - 04/2025	Hyderabad

Power Platform Developer responsible for designing, supporting, and enhancing PowerApps solutions across the organization. Act as a subject matter expert, guiding teams on best practices, governance, and new capabilities within PowerApps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Copilot Studio. Provide end-to-end support including troubleshooting, performance tuning, and issue resolution. Collaborate with stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and user-centric applications aligned with business needs. Lead automation initiatives, documentation, and knowledge-sharing to drive platform adoption and continuous improvement, while leveraging Copilot Studio to build intelligent copilots and conversational automation solutions.

PowerApps Subject matter expert

Sonata Software

04/2025 - 11/2025	Hyderabad

Power Platform Developer responsible for designing, supporting, and enhancing PowerApps solutions across the organization. Act as a subject matter expert, guiding teams on best practices, governance, and new capabilities within PowerApps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Copilot Studio. Provide end-to-end support including troubleshooting, performance tuning, and issue resolution. Collaborate with stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and user-centric applications aligned with business needs. Lead automation initiatives, documentation, and knowledge-sharing to drive platform adoption and continuous improvement, while leveraging Copilot Studio to build intelligent copilots and conversational automation solutions.

PowerApps Developer

Wafer wire Cloud Technologies

11/2025 - Present	Hyderabad

Develop and enhance business applications using PowerApps and Dataverse. Build intelligent copilots with Copilot Studio to automate workflows and improve user experience. Collaborate with teams to integrate solutions, troubleshoot issues, and implement best practices for scalable and secure applications.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of technology

NS Raju institute of technology

02/2018 - 08/2021	Visakhapatnam

Courses -

Electrical and Electronics Engineering -7.2 CGPA

SKILLS

PROJECTS

McCain Product Services Application (02/2023 - 04/2024)

Designed and implemented a region-specific product request application using PowerApps, supporting operations across four global regions. The app allows users to select their region, choose from six core products, and respond to dynamic, product-specific questions. Requests are generated within the app and routed through a sequential approval process, where teams review and approve directly via gallery-based controls. A dedicated dashboard enables users to track request status and view team-level approvals or rejections. Oversaw app design, security role configuration, administration, and provided ongoing support to ensure reliability and compliance across environments.

Reporting Application (05/2024 - 02/2025)

Leveraged Copilot Studio to create an AI chatbot that interacts with users to log time and track work progress. User-submitted data is automatically saved to SharePoint, sent to the manager via email, and updated in the relevant Teams channel. Ensured a seamless, automated workﬂow that improves reporting accuracy and team collaboration. Designed with a focus on scalability, security, and user-friendly experience.

Project Name

Automated BPF and Data Validation Solution (05/2025 - 10/2025)

Developed a model-driven application to validate and manage business process data efficiently across multiple tables.

Implemented data and metadata validation by mapping records from two grid tables, ensuring accuracy before processing. Enabled users to complete stages in a Business Process Flow (BPF) and submit it to trigger automated workﬂows. Integrated with client systems to fetch and update data from the client tenant via automated ﬂows. Improved operational efficiency by ensuring data integrity and automating cross-system updates.

CERTIFICATIONS

PL900 - Power Platform Certification (01/2023 - Present)

Copilot studio Certification from zero to hero for Udemy (02/2024 - Present)

INTERESTS

Basketball Dance Cooking
